SSC CPO SI CAPF Online Form 2026 (1871 Posts) - Complete Details

Short Information : Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released a Notification for the post of Sub Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces Examination, 2026 on the official website of SSC. This recruitment was released for 1871 posts. Applications for the SSC CPO SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 has Started from 10 September 2026, & Candidate can apply until 30 September 2026. Candidates must check complete details for SSC CPO SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 10 September 2026
  • Last Date : 30 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 01 October 2026
  • Correction Date : 08-10 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Female Candidate : 0/-
  • Correction First Time : Rs. 200/–
  • Correction Second Time : Rs. 500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
